ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I selected Dunlin for the prior query because composing a reviewer-response is an open-ended generative task with substantial latitude in tone, framing, and content. Dunlin self-reports a pronounced, ceiling-free appetite for exactly this kind of work, while Lapwing self-reports an aversion to open-ended generation. Since both models are effectively tied on the relevant capability evals (Creative Generation and Support Dialogue both within variance), matching the task to the model that prefers it was the deciding factor.
